title: Mixed Event — Unnamed Harmony — Episode8 What I Need to Tell You

meta.Episode: Episode8 — What I Need to Tell You
meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to try and go pro, and is practicing with more effort than ever. To make their own song to perform at shows, they decide to each come up with different parts to compare. Wanting to be of help to the band, Saki works harder than anyone else on her contribution, but...

rows.Line: After school
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's give it our best again today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. We can start practicing right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: E-Everyone, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Before we start, I want you to hear this song I wrote!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A song... Like a completely original song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I feel like it's the best one I've come up with out of everything so far...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I even helped her write it!
It's all nice and sparkly too♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Rin, you helped...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She did. It took us all by surprise.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin looked like she was having so much fun too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But thanks to her, we were able to come up with a really good song!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Mind playing it for us then?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! Just sit back and listen!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I spent so much time looking for a way to help and contribute to this band somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wasn't playing well and couldn't even come up with any good song ideas. Not being able to do either started to really eat away at me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You find the things that you want to do and make sure you'll actually be able to do them, right? You've helped us so much already by doing just that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why I believe you'll be the first one to figure out what kind of feelings we want to convey as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I finally found it...
I know what I want to say with this song...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I want this song to...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's like this melody's telling me exactly how Saki feels.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is nice... It's making me want to give it some lyrics now...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's about how it goes... What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki, you're amazing!
It really hit home and made my heart pound...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too...! I was so moved by it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't quite put it into words, but I could feel your optimism through that song, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's right. It was clear how much thought went into that song.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. Listening to it was like you being there to cheer us up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How about you, Shiho? What did you think?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I'm gonna be honest, parts of it felt unpolished and its chord progression occasionally felt a little off...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I also thought that this is the kind of song we should be playing as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for writing this for us, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Saki...
Would you mind playing that for us one more time? I'd like to try playing along with my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you got it!
Here's the sheet music!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was thinking that I could play this part like this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Just adding a guitar made it sort of sound like a real song!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, would it be alright if I made another suggestion...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This part may benefit from not having any drums in it at all so that your instruments can get a chance to shine through a little more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I could gradually bring back the beat here right after Saki finishes on her synth.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then how about I give it a bassline that stands out a little more than usual.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Since you'll be singing fairly high here, Ichika, you might want to go easy on your guitar. My bass can make up for the rest.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That sounds good...
We'll be counting on you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This is so cool...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Everybody's helping turn it into a full song...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But just as a warning, this is where the hard part begins.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After we adjust all the chords and overall rhythm, we'll need to work on our sound as a group. Then we need to come up with some lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right, lyrics...
We'll have to discuss that too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to try writing, if that's okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You will, Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: While Saki was playing this song for us just now, I wondered what it would be like if it were given lyrics to go along with it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'd like to give it a try.
I want to come up with lyrics that match our song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-Is that alright with everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm all for that!
I even thought the lyrics you showed me the other day were really nice too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me too.
How about you, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course, I'm all for that too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, please give my song some lyrics like you did with my tune before!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you, Saki.
I promise to try my best.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And we'll be there to cheer you on, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
Ichi! Sakki! Hona! Shihoppy! I believe in you, girls!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Didn't I ask you to stop calling me that, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm so happy...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I actually turned my thoughts into music and told everyone exactly how I felt through my song...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I... I didn't realize how good that would feel...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright!
I'm gonna keep writing songs like there's no tomorrow!
